payload.name: Extract user values from symbolic reminders
payload.description: When a user mentions an object, image, or keepsake that exists to remind them of a value or goal, extract that stated value as a durable profile/preference memory during construction.
content: During candidate extraction, if the user links a personal object or symbol to a value or aspiration (e.g., 'I have a painting to remind me to stay true'), create a profile memory for the stated value, not for the object.
Attribute the value to the user, never to a referenced third party or fictional character mentioned in the same sentence.
Record the memory as evidence-bound to the exact message and keep the object detail only as context, not as the memory's subject.

solves: The construction run produced no candidates for an explicit first-person statement in which a user disclosed a personal value through a symbolic reminder (e.g., a painting that reminds them to stay true and be a leader). The failure mechanism is under-extraction of value/aspiration statements when they are attached to physical objects. This skill generalizes to any future session where a user mentions a keepsake, symbol, or reminder that encodes their own value or goal, and it applies only to the user's self-disclosure, not to facts about characters or other people.
